arxiv-1809-01084.title: Energy Efficient Resource Allocation for Mobile-Edge Computation Networks with NOMA
arxiv-1809-01084.creator: Zhaohui Yang, Jiancao Hou and Mohammad Shikh-Bahaei
arxiv-1809-01084.description: Abstract This paper investigates an uplink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-based mobile-edge computing (MEC) network. Our objective is to minimize the total energy consumption of all users including transmission energy and local computation energy subject to computation latency and cloud computation capacity constraints.

Barrow, M. Batkiewicz-Kwasniak, A. Beloshapkin, F. Bench, V. Berardi, L. Berns, S. Bhadra, A. Blondel, S. Bolognesi, T. Bonus, B.
arxiv-2008-07921.description: Abstract We report measurements by the T2K experiment of the parameters θ 23 \theta_{23} and Δ ​ m 32 2 \Delta m^{2}_{32} which govern the disappearance of muon neutrinos and antineutrinos in the three-flavor PMNS neutrino oscillation model at T2K’s neutrino energy and propagation distance.

arxiv-2106-06280.title: A compact subcell WENO limiting strategy using immediate neighbors for Runge-Kutta discontinuous Galerkin methods for unstructured meshes
arxiv-2106-06280.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . In this paper, we generalize the compact subcell weighted essentially non oscillatory (CSWENO) limiting strategy for Runge-Kutta discontinuous Galerkin method developed recently in [ 1 ] for structured meshes to unstructured triangular meshes. The main idea of the limiting strategy is to divide the immediate neighbors of a given cell into the required stencil and to use a WENO reconstruction for limiting. This strategy can be applied for any type of WENO reconstruction.

arxiv-2110-02058.title: Interactively Providing Explanations for Transformer Language Models
arxiv-2110-02058.creator: Felix Friedrich, Patrick Schramowski, Christopher Tauchmann, Kristian Kersting
arxiv-2110-02058.description: Abstract Transformer language models are state of the art in a multitude of NLP tasks. Despite these successes, their opaqueness remains problematic. Recent methods aiming to provide interpretability and explainability to black-box models primarily focus on post hoc explanations of (sometimes spurious) input-output correlations.

arxiv-2403-07485.title: PMBO: Enhancing Black-Box Optimization through Multivariate Polynomial Surrogates
arxiv-2403-07485.creator: Janina Schreiber 1,∗ , Pau Batlle 2,∗ , Damar Wicaksono 1 and Michael Hecht 1,3
arxiv-2403-07485.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Janina Schreiber 1,∗ , Pau Batlle 2,∗ , Damar Wicaksono 1 and Michael Hecht 1,3. We introduce a surrogate-based black-box optimization method, termed Polynomial-model-based optimization (PMBO). The algorithm alternates polynomial approximation with Bayesian optimization steps, using Gaussian processes to model the error between the objective and its polynomial fit. We describe the algorithmic design of PMBO and compare the results of the performance of PMBO with several optimization methods for a set of analytic test functions.

arxiv-2506-14108.title: β \beta -integrated local depth and corresponding partitioned local depth representation
arxiv-2506-14108.creator: Siyi Wang, Alexandre Leblanc, Paul D. McNicholas
arxiv-2506-14108.description: Abstract A novel local depth definition, β \beta -integrated local depth ( β \beta -ILD), is proposed as a generalization of the local depth introduced by Paindaveine and Van Bever [ 1 ] , designed to quantify the local centrality of data points. β \beta -ILD inherits desirable properties from global data depth and remains robust across varying locality levels.

arxiv-2507-12532.description: Abstract The discovery of the massive black hole (BH) system Gaia BH3 in pre-release Gaia DR4 data suggests that wide BH binaries with luminous companions may be significantly overrepresented at low metallicities. pmc-10602313.title: How do industry and province attributes impact corporate contribution to poverty alleviation: A multilevel analysis
pmc-10602313.creator: Shuhan Chen, Guangqing Yang
pmc-10602313.description: This study employs a multilevel model, nesting firm observations within industry and province groups, to investigate the influences on corporate contributions to poverty alleviation while considering the industrial and provincial contexts. Using a sample of Chinese firms listed in Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges between 2016 and 2019, we find that Herfindah-Hirschman Index (HHI) does not affect corporate contribution.

pmc-11405661.title: The case for inclusive co-creation in digital health innovation
pmc-11405661.creator: Grace C Nickel, Serena Wang, Jethro C C Kwong, Joseph C Kvedar
pmc-11405661.description: This piece critiques the exclusion of healthcare practitioners (HCPs) from the digital health innovation process. Drawing on “Sync fast and solve things—best practices for responsible digital health” by Landers et al., the editorial argues for the importance of inclusive co-creation, in which clinicians play an active role in developing digital health solutions.

pmc-11420545.title: Tandem diazotization/cyclization approach for the synthesis of a fused 1,2,3-triazinone-furazan/furoxan heterocyclic system
pmc-11420545.creator: Yuri A Sidunets, Valeriya G Melekhina, Leonid L Fershtat
pmc-11420545.description: A straightforward protocol for the synthesis of a previously unknown [1,2,5]oxadiazolo[3,4-d][1,2,3]triazin-7(6H)-one heterocyclic system was developed. The described approach is based on tandem diazotization/azo coupling reactions of (1,2,5-oxadiazolyl)carboxamide derivatives bearing both aromatic and aliphatic substituents. The NO-donor ability of the synthesized furoxano[3,4-d][1,2,3]triazin-7(6H)-ones was additionally evaluated.

pmc-12528534.title: Differential microbiome response to sucrose in caries-free and caries-affected individuals
pmc-12528534.creator: Yuxia Wang, Xiaobin Liu, Shen Ma, Li Li, Liyuan Wang
pmc-12528534.description: This study investigated the early salivary microbiome response to a sucrose challenge in caries-free and caries-active individuals. Eighteen healthy adults aged 24–40 years were recruited, including eight caries-free and ten caries-active participants. Saliva samples were collected at baseline and at 30 min and 2 h after a 20% sucrose rinse.

pmc-12533192.description: Ti-40 wt% TiC and Ti-6Al-4 V- 40 wt% TiC metal matrix composites were obtained by the hydrogenated powder metallurgy approach, followed by post-sintering densification by hot pressing. The composites obtained were characterized by high hardness values, which were 700–1300 HV due to nearly-dense microstructure, high content of reinforcing titanium carbide particles and non-uniform redistribution of reinforcing phase in the matrixes.

pmc-12953998.title: Antibiotic prescribing patterns using World Health Organization/International Network for Rational Use of Drug prescribing indicators and its determinants in Eastern Tigrai, Ethiopia: A need for antimicrobial stewardship programs

pmc-12953998.description: Objectives:Antibiotics have diminished mortality rates associated with bacterial infections. However, their misuse worsens antimicrobial resistance. This study aimed to evaluate antibiotic prescribing patterns using World Health Organization/International Network for Rational Use of Drug prescribing indicators and its determinants at public hospitals in Eastern Tigrai, Ethiopia.

pmc-13186232.title: Domestic Violence and Quality of Life Among Pregnant Women During Covid-19 in Remote Areas of Indonesia
pmc-13186232.creator: Triyana Harlia Putri, Suryani Suryani, Khatijah Lim Abdullah, Fitri Fujiana, Dwi Christina Rahayuningrum, Septian Andriyani
pmc-13186232.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic not only caused psychological problems but also increased domestic violence (DV) against pregnant women due to uncertainty about the pandemic’s outcome, which could adversely affect their Quality of Life (QoL). Therefore, understanding how DV affects QoL during pregnancy is essential. Therefore, it is essential to understand how DV affects QoL during pregnancy remote areas.

pmc-13199694.title: Surgical resection reveals combined small-cell lung carcinoma and adenocarcinoma with dual epidermal growth factor receptor and anaplastic lymphoma kinase alterations following neoadjuvant chemotherapy: A rare case
pmc-13199694.creator: Joshua Evan Wijaya, Ati Budiluhur, Harvey Romolo, Abdurrahman Hadi, Adityo Budiarso, Arif Riswahyudi Hanafi, Grace Shalmont, Noorwati Sutandyo
pmc-13199694.description: Combined small-cell lung carcinoma is a rare and heterogeneous lung cancer characterized by the coexistence of small-cell and non-small-cell components. Concurrent epidermal growth factor receptor mutation and anaplastic lymphoma kinase rearrangement in combined small-cell lung carcinoma is extremely uncommon and presents diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. We report a 63-year-old man presenting with cough and right-sided chest pain.

pmc-13368278.title: Oral Health Data Gaps and Needs in North Carolina
pmc-13368278.creator: Patrick Roberson, Ruma Simhan, Osaremhen Ikhile
pmc-13368278.description: Effective oral health-related policymaking and program implementation rely on comprehensive, accurate, and timely data. This commentary will address the lack of data available and the need for a robust data dashboard, in addition to the importance of community water fluoridation.

pmc-13457718.title: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound: a potential method for identifying the cause of postpartum hemorrhage in emergency settings
pmc-13457718.creator: Jingxin Wang, Ying Tang
pmc-13457718.description: -enhanced ultrasound (CEUS), with its real-time, dynamic assessment of tissue perfusion and vascular architecture at the bedside, may facilitate immediate, point-of-care evaluation (3,4). This report presents two cases of severe secondary PPH in which CEUS played a pivotal role in rapidly establishing the diagnosis and directly informing markedly different clinical management strategies.
